items.label: FLIMBO'S QUEST
items.why: Boot PRG unpacks the resident game behind the Soldiers and Illusion/ATC intros and the trainer. It also carries the loading presentation that is overwritten.

items.label: FLIMBO'S STORY
items.why: Standalone animated documentation, confirmed by separately autostarting the second PRG and observing its chapter-one story viewer. The crack note identifies it as the docs file.

items.label: FLIMBO'S NOTE
items.why: Standalone tokenized BASIC document from Illusion and ATC, explaining the disk extras and the trainer choices.
